title: November 2026 release candidate (internal draft)
summary: Proposed Web improvements and a beta Chat assistant update. This is an internal candidate only; production availability, final product scope, and a separate publication approval remain pending.

items: Proposed: optional, editable recipe and brew loss estimates with documented assumptions; recorded brew volumes remain measurements.
Proposed: create a brew directly from a newly saved, owned, or public recipe, with source attribution and an explicit snapshot-refresh action.
Proposed: four additional visual themes for the website.
Proposed beta update: a streamlined brewing assistant using shared tools, clearer progress reporting, and sensor-history summaries with measurement provenance.
